name: Clawed Fiend

bonuses.name: Hunting Senses
bonuses.text: This Threat suffers no penalty to Tests due to darkness.

abilities.name: Fearsome Beast
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Tail Spike
abilities.text: The Clawed Fiend makes an immediate attack with its Tail Spike at any target in range.

abilities.name: Berserk Rage
abilities.text: Whenever this Threat suffers a Wound, roll 1d6. If you roll an Icon, this Threat gains 1 personal Ruin. If you roll an Exalted Icon, this Threat gains 2 personal Ruin.

note: Reprint of litanies-clawed-fiend (Litanies of the Lost); differs only in this printing's Tier row (A A E E T; Litanies prints none) and the "Dodge:" label on Determination. Stats and weapons match. Tail Spike sits in the WRATH ability.
